reference.caveat: powermetrics reports per-subsystem SoC power from Apple's own model; the vendor documents these values as estimated. This is an independent, higher-directness reference, not ground truth, and it excludes display, storage, networking, and PSU losses.

confidence_vs_error.expected_sign: negative (higher confidence should mean lower error)
confidence_vs_error.note: with two provenance classes this is a two-group comparison expressed as a rank correlation; it tests ordering, not a dose-response relationship

verdict.reading: the method the policy trusts more (codecarbon, confidence 0.3) is closer to the independent reference than manual_flop (confidence 0.2): median absolute error 106.11% vs 202.99%. The assigned ordering is consistent with observed error on this host.
